summary:
Test passes. The bug was in `computeHandler` (`/app/app/main.go`): it spawned a goroutine running `performComputation` with no awareness of the request context, so client disconnects didn't stop the work — leaking a goroutine per abandoned request for up to 25s (or longer, since the sleep loop had no exit).

Fix: pass `r.Context()` into `performComputation`, check `ctx.Done()` before each iteration and during the delay `time.Sleep`, and select on `ctx.Done()` in the handler so a disconnect returns immediately instead of waiting for the 25s timeout.
